proposed_edit.new_declaration:
theorem Submodule.starProjection_le_starProjection_iff {U V : Submodule 𝕜 E}
    [U.HasOrthogonalProjection] [V.HasOrthogonalProjection] :
    U.starProjection ≤ V.starProjection ↔ U ≤ V := by
  simp_rw
    [← coe_le_coe_iff,
      isSymmetricProjection_starProjection _
        |>.le_iff_range_le_range <| isSymmetricProjection_starProjection _,
      coe_starProjection_eq_isComplProjection,
      IsCompl.projection_range]

candidates.requested_change: Reformat the `simp_rw` call by placing the bracketed rewrite list on its own indented block with one entry per line and a trailing bracket on its own line.

candidates.claim:
In `LinearMap.IsSymmetricProjection.le_iff_range_le_range`, the long `simp_rw [...] at h2` list is kept in a mostly single block: `simp_rw [sub_apply, inner_sub_left, map_sub, hh hq, hh hp,
    hp.isIdempotentElem.mem_range_iff.mp ha, sub_nonneg, sq_le_sq, abs_norm] at h2`. This exceeds the typical one-item-per-line list formatting used nearby in the file for longer rewrite collections.
candidates.concern_label: multiline simp_rw list formatting in long simp_rw ... at

proposed_edit.new_declaration:
theorem IsSymmetricProjection.le_iff_range_le_range {p q : E →ₗ[𝕜] E}
    (hp : p.IsSymmetricProjection) (hq : q.IsSymmetricProjection) : p ≤ q ↔ range p ≤ range q := by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ a ha ↦ ?_, fun hpq ↦ (hp.sub_of_range_le_range hq hpq).isPositive⟩
  specialize h2 a
  have hh {T : E →ₗ[𝕜] E} (hT : T.IsSymmetricProjection) : RCLike.re ⟪T a, a⟫_𝕜 = ‖T a‖ ^ 2 := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← hT.isIdempotentElem]
    rw [Module.End.mul_apply, hT.isSymmetric]
    exact inner_self_eq_norm_sq _
  simp_rw
    [sub_apply,
      inner_sub_left,
      map_sub,
      hh hq,
      hh hp,
      hp.isIdempotentElem.mem_range_iff.mp ha,
      sub_nonneg,
      sq_le_sq,
      abs_norm] at h2
  obtain ⟨U, _, rfl⟩ := isSymmetricProjection_iff_eq_coe_starProjection.mp hq
  simpa [Submodule.coe_starProjection_eq_isComplProjection] using
    U.mem_iff_norm_starProjection _ |>.mpr <| le_antisymm (U.norm_starProjection_apply_le a) h2

candidates.requested_change: Reformat the `simp_rw` call to put the rewrite list in a multiline bracket block with one lemma per line (and align the closing bracket before `at h2`).

Tried replacing the `simp_rw` chain in `Submodule.starProjection_le_starProjection_iff` with `simp`/`simpa`; it did not close the goal, while the existing `simp_rw` (or a minor parenthesization of `le_iff_range_le_range`) is already the idiomatic approach here; `IsSymmetricProjection.le_iff_range_le_range` similarly appears appropriately structured with a final `simpa`.
